campaign_objective_description: Remind customers about their upcoming scheduled service appointments to ensure vehicle maintenance and customer satisfaction
why_user_should_avail_this: Regular service ensures optimal vehicle performance, safety, and maintains warranty coverage
reasons_users_may_not_be_interested: Vehicle recently serviced elsewhere, financial constraints, inconvenient timing
reasons_for_non_applicability: Vehicle already serviced, outside service area, warranty expired
other_important_information: Service appointments can be scheduled at your convenience. Early booking may qualify for discounts.

custom_attributes.attribute_description: Days before due date when reminders are sent

campaign_objective_description: Promote extended warranty packages to customers whose vehicles are nearing warranty expiry
why_user_should_avail_this: Extended warranty provides peace of mind and protects against unexpected repair costs at discounted rates
reasons_users_may_not_be_interested: Vehicle in excellent condition, plans to sell soon, budget constraints
reasons_for_non_applicability: Warranty already expired, vehicle sold, not eligible for extension
other_important_information: Special discount available for early renewal. Coverage includes comprehensive protection for major components.

campaign_objective_description: Generate test drive bookings by encouraging potential customers to experience the vehicle firsthand
why_user_should_avail_this: Experience the premium features and performance of NEXA vehicles with no obligation
reasons_users_may_not_be_interested: Not ready to purchase, already test driven, preference for other models
reasons_for_non_applicability: Already purchased, outside service area, not eligible for test drive
other_important_information: Test drives are free and include home pickup/drop service. No pressure sales approach.

custom_attributes.attribute_description: Number of test drive slots allocated daily
Indicates if home pickup/drop is available

campaign_objective_description: Create awareness and generate excitement for newly launched vehicles with special launch offers
why_user_should_avail_this: Be among the first to own the latest model with exclusive launch offers and benefits
reasons_users_may_not_be_interested: Prefer established models, waiting for reviews, budget constraints
reasons_for_non_applicability: Already purchased, not available in region, not eligible for offers
other_important_information: Launch offers are limited and available for early bookings. Includes special pricing and accessories package.
